_about: Task v09 suite b: long multi-sentence replies (recipes, lists, explain, 7-day forecast) that trigger piece-boundary echo (issue #72, task v09).

cases.prompt: Give me a recipe for chocolate chip cookies.
How do I make banana bread from scratch?

cases.prompt: Tell me step by step how to cook chicken soup.
cases.rubric: Gives a multi-step chicken soup recipe.

cases.prompt: Give me a list of the ten best mountains in the world.
Name five interesting facts about the ocean.

cases.prompt: Explain why the sky changes colors at sunset.
cases.rubric: Explains sunset colors in several sentences.

cases.prompt: Give me a 7-day weather forecast for San Diego.
